node.statement: Apply validated node 1.1.4 to the nonvanishing Q from the preceding child. It supplies universal constants c_u=1/2 and e_u>0 such that every H-CB datum with e<=e_u has ||u_Q||>=1/2. The antecedent of that conditional validated result is now discharged by an allowed registered definition, not assumed.
